Reason words: An unfilled rubber (TPU, PEBA, OBC, TPE, TPS, TPV, PVC-P)
Basis: A thermoplastic elastomer is soft because its chains are held only at their hard blocks. The Cambridge Materials Data Book's table of Young's modulus (II.3, p. 11 of the book, PDF p. 13; Granta Design's data) prints every elastomer class it lists between 0.0007 and 0.04 GPa: polyurethane elastomers (elPU) 0.002-0.003 GPa, EVA 0.01-0.04, silicone elastomers 0.005-0.02. Its rigid thermoplastic polyurethanes (tpPU, 1.31-2.07 GPa) are not elastomers and not this kind: a rubbery TPU filament is sold by its Shore A or soft Shore D hardness. The limit is set well above the book's elastomers, at the experts' 0.5 GPa (C32, V26; Shore 95A is about 0.04 GPa), because the hardest unfilled elastomer filaments here, Shore D TPUs, publish 0.39 to 0.40 GPa; the kind's own published maximum widens it further where a product prints more, and the engine's 10 % scatter is added before it fails anything. It holds for the materials whose base polymer is a thermoplastic elastomer: those whose polymers.csv row is an elastomer (TPU, TPE, PEBA, TPC, OBC), and since stage 3d of the screening build the three Flexible Elastomers kinds polymers.csv does not model, the maker-undisclosed TPE, TPS and TPV, whose products publish 0.011 to 0.15 GPa. Formfutura Crystal Flex (SBC, a Shore 63D styrenic with a 1.8 GPa flexural modulus) is not a rubber and is left out. Since the owner's rulings of 2026-10-20 (m477, D176) it also holds for the plasticised PVC (PVC-P, M178): a plasticiser lowers PVC's glass transition below room temperature and its small crystallites hold the chains as a thermoplastic elastomer's hard blocks do, and its product, purefil's "Polyvinylchlorid weich 94A", is rated on the Shore A scale (94A, about 0.04 GPa by Gent's relation) with "gummiähnliche Eigenschaften"; it publishes no modulus, so the limit decides alone.

Reason words: An unfilled product of its polymer
Basis: Without a filler, a filament's density is its polymer's: unfilled PLA cannot exceed 1,330 kg/m³ (C32, V26). The range is the neat range polymers.csv records for the material's polymer, read only where that row names a registered source, and widened to the kind's own published extremes among its products that are not variants. It decides for the 38 polymers whose row names a registered source (22 of them recorded by stage 2c of the screening build, and PCTG, HIPS, PA6/66 and PVB by the research intake, m453); a polymer row that names none bounds nothing.
